contentEn.description:
free wifi

 

 Comfortable studio apartment with breathtaking southeast-facing sea views, ideally situated in the iconic Mediterranean Building on the beachfront, right in the heart of Marbella. This prime location provides easy access to all the amenities the city has to offer, making a car unnecessary for your stay. Perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking a relaxing seaside escape.

 The studio features a spacious terrace with panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. The southeast orientation ensures you enjoy beautiful sunrises and ample natural light throughout the day. Inside, you will find a cozy living-dining area with a TV, a fully equipped kitchen with all essentials, and a sleeping area with two comfortable single beds. The bathroom is fitted with a modern shower.

 Located on the 6th floor with convenient access via elevators, the studio offers an exceptional vantage point over Marbella’s promenade, marina, and the charming Avenida del Mar adorned with Salvador Dalí statues. Whether you are enjoying breakfast on the terrace or unwinding after a day at the beach, this studio promises a memorable stay with unbeatable views and comfort.

 🌐 Own Wifi throughout the apartment, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ A/C in the living room.

 🔑 Check-in from 4 pm: keys at reception, open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 🛌 The rental price includes bed linen, a set of towels and a beach towel per guest.

 🚗 The property does not have parking. You can park on the street or in public parking lots; The closest car parks are on Avenida del Mar and Edificio Marbella Centro. This note is merely informative; We are an external agency.
amenities: Centro de negocios con wifi gratis
